label: rejected

evidence.V1: Rounded faceted lump reads as a boulder from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette.
evidence.V2: One big mass plus a moss cap; no medium ledges or small chips/pebbles, so hierarchy is only partial.
evidence.V3: Generic blob with evenly sized facets; not much stylised exaggeration (no strong top plane or leaning mass).
evidence.V4: Some facet edges carry a thin light-catching chamfer (e.g. the line across the front face) while others are hard creases; inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Visible triangulation star/X shading pattern on the moss top facet in the studio close-up and a faint diagonal crease across the dark lower face; no seams or z-fighting.
evidence.V6: Stone hue in 3 values plus one moss green secondary, as the nature brief allows; good value contrast.
evidence.V8: Moss follows facet borders exactly as hard-edged painted faces, reading like a coloured lid rather than moss; otherwise matches LF_VertexColor and designed facets.
evidence.V9: Static scenery studio line correct: Anchored, Hull, CanTouch off, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: triangulation star shading on the moss top facet
faint diagonal crease across the lower dark facet
